review: 1:1 הִנֵּה־זֶה — the deictic הִנֵּה with זֶה, for هُوَذَا; the compound keeps 'behold' emphatic without an extra syllable.
2:1 לֶחֶם הַשָּׁמַיִם — 'the bread of heaven' (Ex 16:4, John 6:32); the Arabic الْخُبْزُ السَّمَاوِيّ is the same title.
3:2 עַל־הַדֶּלֶת הוּא דוֹפֵק — Revelation 3:20 (הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל־הַדֶּלֶת וְדֹפֵק), quoted because the Arabic عَلَى الْبَابِ يَقْرَعُ is that verse.
3:3 עֶזִּי — the pausal form of עֹז with the 1cs suffix, 'my strength'; the fuller עֻזִּי would add a syllable the tune does not have.
